friendly_name.label: Display Name
friendly_name.description: What this source shows up as in Live Inputs and on players.

icon_preset.label: Thumbnail
icon_preset.description: Pick a bundled icon or use a custom image URL.

thumbnail_image.label: Thumbnail image URL
thumbnail_image.description: Direct URL to an SVG/PNG/JPG, e.g. https://example.com/icon.svg

include_monitors.label: Include monitor sources
include_monitors.description: When enabled, sink monitor sources (loopback capture of what's currently playing on an output) also appear in the Audio Input Device list below.

input_device.label: Audio Input Device
input_device.description: Select a PulseAudio/PipeWire capture source (pactl list sources).

auto_trigger.label: Auto-start on signal
auto_trigger.description: Watch the input for signal and automatically start/stop playback on a chosen player — for devices that are always connected (e.g. a USB sound card) rather than selected on demand from Live Inputs.

target_player_id.label: Auto-start target player
target_player_id.description: Which player to start automatically when signal is detected. 'Auto' prefers whichever player is currently playing, falling back to the first available player.

trigger_threshold_dbfs.label: Signal threshold (dBFS)
trigger_threshold_dbfs.description: RMS level above which the input counts as active audio. Higher (closer to 0) = less sensitive, lower = more sensitive to quiet signals and background noise.

manifest.description: Pipe realtime audio from a PulseAudio/PipeWire capture source (e.g. Bluetooth receiver or line-in) to any Music Assistant player.

monitors.title: Local Audio Source
monitors.description: Sink monitor sources (loopback capture of what's playing on an output) can optionally be included in the device list on the next step.

device.title: Select Audio Input
device.description: Pick the PulseAudio/PipeWire source this instance should capture from.

errors.no_packets: No audio could be captured from source {0} for '{1}'.
